name: Download a Build Artifact
description: Download a build artifact that was previously uploaded in the workflow by the upload-artifact action

name.description: Name of the artifact to download. If unspecified, all artifacts for the run are downloaded.

artifact-ids.description: IDs of the artifacts to download, comma-separated. Either inputs `artifact-ids` or `name` can be used, but not both.

path.description: Destination path. Supports basic tilde expansion. Defaults to $GITHUB_WORKSPACE

pattern.description: A glob pattern matching the artifacts that should be downloaded. Ignored if name is specified.

merge-multiple.description: When multiple artifacts are matched, this changes the behavior of the destination directories. If true, the downloaded artifacts will be in the same directory s

github-token.description: The GitHub token used to authenticate with the GitHub API. This is required when downloading artifacts from a different repository or from a different workflow

repository.description: The repository owner and the repository name joined together by "/". If github-token is specified, this is the repository that artifacts will be downloaded from

run-id.description: The id of the workflow run where the desired download artifact was uploaded from. If github-token is specified, this is the run that artifacts will be downloade
